identity.description: An attacker attempts to brute-force RDP access using Windows command-line tools, generating multiple failed login attempts from a single host. Cortex should detect the unusual RDP-related process execution and network connections.

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: RDP Brute Force Attempt
biocs.description: Multiple failed RDP connection attempts from same host
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'net.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'net.exe'
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.10'
| filter dst_port = 445
